content.user_title: Build Effective Claude Code Plugin Skills
content.value_statement: Creating a well-structured Claude Code skill requires knowing the right file layout, description format, and content organization. This skill provides a step-by-step process for writing clear, discoverable skills that load efficiently through progressive disclosure.
actual_capabilities: Explains the required SKILL.md structure and YAML frontmatter fields (name, description).
Guides writing third-person descriptions with specific trigger phrases so skills activate reliably.
Describes the three-level progressive disclosure model (metadata, SKILL.md body, bundled resources).
Shows how to organize scripts, references, and assets directories for reusable skill content.
Provides a validation checklist and common mistakes to avoid before finalizing a skill.
Includes a full step-by-step skill creation process from concrete examples to iteration.
limitations: Provides written guidance only; it does not generate, package, or install skills automatically.
Focused on Claude Code plugin skills, not general-purpose application code.
Does not validate or test a skill's runtime behavior; it offers checklists and conventions only.
Best-practice targets such as word counts are recommendations, not enforced rules.

use_cases.title: Write a first plugin skill
use_cases.description: A plugin author uses the step-by-step process to structure a new SKILL.md file with strong trigger phrases and lean content.
use_cases.target_user: Plugin developers new to Claude Code skills

use_cases.title: Improve an existing skill's discoverability
use_cases.description: A maintainer rewrites a vague description into third-person trigger phrases so the skill activates on the right user queries.

use_cases.title: Reorganize skill content for context efficiency
use_cases.description: A team applies progressive disclosure to move detailed material out of SKILL.md into references files, keeping the body lean.

prompt_templates.title: Create a new skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me create a skill for my Claude Code plugin that helps users rotate and edit PDF files.
prompt_templates.scenario: Starting a new skill from scratch

prompt_templates.title: Improve a skill description
prompt_templates.prompt: Improve the description of my skill so it triggers reliably when users ask to work with hooks.

prompt_templates.title: Organize skill content
prompt_templates.prompt: My SKILL.md is over 6,000 words. Help me organize the content using progressive disclosure and move detail into references files.

prompt_templates.title: Review a skill against best practices
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my SKILL.md and the references directory, then tell me which best practices it violates and how to fix each one before I publish.

output_examples.input: Help me write a description for a skill that creates Claude Code hooks.
output_examples.output: A third-person description with concrete trigger phrases, such as: This skill should be used when the user asks to create a hook, add a PreToolUse hook, or validate tool use.

output_examples.input: How should I structure a skill with detailed reference material?
output_examples.output: Guidance to keep SKILL.md lean at roughly 1,500 to 2,000 words and move detailed patterns and advanced techniques into a references directory that loads only when needed.

best_practices: Write descriptions in third person and include the exact phrases users would say to trigger the skill.
Keep SKILL.md lean, around 1,500 to 2,000 words, and move detailed material into references files.
Write the skill body in imperative form and reference every supporting script, example, and asset.
anti_patterns: Using vague descriptions without concrete trigger phrases, which prevents the skill from activating.
Placing all content in a single large SKILL.md file instead of using progressive disclosure.
Writing in second person and leaving bundled resources unreferenced in the skill body.

faq.question: What is this skill for?
faq.answer: It provides guidance for creating well-structured skills for Claude Code plugins, including layout, descriptions, and content organization.

faq.question: What files does a skill need?
faq.answer: Every skill requires a SKILL.md file with YAML frontmatter. Scripts, references, and assets directories are optional bundled resources.

faq.question: What is progressive disclosure?
faq.answer: It is a three-level loading model. Metadata is always in context, the SKILL.md body loads when the skill triggers, and bundled resources load only as needed.

faq.question: How do I make a skill trigger reliably?
faq.answer: Write the description in third person and include specific phrases that users would actually type, such as create a hook or configure the server.

faq.question: How long should SKILL.md be?
faq.answer: The recommended target is 1,500 to 2,000 words. Move detailed patterns and advanced material into references files to keep the body lean.

faq.question: Does this skill build the skill for me?
faq.answer: No. It provides written guidance, a creation process, and a validation checklist. Authoring, packaging, and testing remain manual steps.
